# Python 实现：词间关系与 n 元组 {#sec-ngrams-python}

本章用 Python 重现第 \@ref(sec-ngrams) 章的内容：二元组（bigram）分析、否定词上下文、词对共现与相关度、网络可视化。Python 端用 **pandas** 做数据操作，**nltk** 分词和停止词，**networkx** 绘制网络图，**matplotlib** 绘图。

## 按二元组分词

从 parquet 读取《红楼梦》英译本，生成二元组（bigram）。

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import nltk
from itertools import pairwise

nltk.download("stopwords", quiet=True)
nltk.download("punkt_tab", quiet=True)
from nltk.corpus import stopwords
en_stopwords = set(stopwords.words("english"))

hongloumeng_en = pd.read_parquet("data/common/hongloumeng_en.parquet")

# 标记 book
hongloumeng_en["book"] = (
    hongloumeng_en["text"].str.contains(r"HUNG LOU MENG, BOOK [I]+", regex=True, na=False).cumsum()
)

# 分词
def tokenize(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    return [w.lower() for w in nltk.word_tokenize(text) if w.isalpha()]

# 生成二元组
def make_bigrams(tokens):
    return [" ".join(pair) for pair in pairwise(tokens)]

hongloumeng_en["tokens"] = hongloumeng_en["text"].apply(tokenize)
bigrams_list = hongloumeng_en["tokens"].apply(make_bigrams)

bigrams = hongloumeng_en[["book"]].copy()
bigrams["bigram"] = bigrams_list
bigrams = bigrams.explode("bigram")
bigrams = bigrams[bigrams["bigram"].str.contains(" ", na=False)]
print(f"二元组总数: {len(bigrams)}")
bigrams.head()
```

### 计算和过滤二元组

```{python}
# 拆分为 word1, word2
bigrams_sep = bigrams["bigram"].str.split(" ", n=1, expand=True)
bigrams_sep.columns = ["word1", "word2"]
bigrams_df = pd.concat([bigrams[["book"]].reset_index(drop=True), bigrams_sep], axis=1)

# 移除停止词
bigrams_filtered = bigrams_df[
    ~bigrams_df["word1"].isin(en_stopwords) & ~bigrams_df["word2"].isin(en_stopwords)
]

bigram_counts = (
    bigrams_filtered.groupby(["word1", "word2"])
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="n")
    .sort_values("n", ascending=False)
)
bigram_counts.head(10)
```

### 三元组

```{python}
def make_trigrams(tokens):
    return [" ".join(tri) for tri in nltk.ngrams(tokens, 3)]

trigrams_list = hongloumeng_en["tokens"].apply(make_trigrams)
trigrams = hongloumeng_en[["book"]].copy()
trigrams["trigram"] = trigrams_list
trigrams = trigrams.explode("trigram")
trigrams = trigrams[trigrams["trigram"].str.count(" ") == 2]

tri_sep = trigrams["trigram"].str.split(" ", expand=True)
tri_sep.columns = ["word1", "word2", "word3"]
tri_df = pd.concat([trigrams[["book"]].reset_index(drop=True), tri_sep], axis=1)
tri_filtered = tri_df[
    ~tri_df["word1"].isin(en_stopwords) &
    ~tri_df["word2"].isin(en_stopwords) &
    ~tri_df["word3"].isin(en_stopwords)
]
tri_counts = tri_filtered.groupby(["word1", "word2", "word3"]).size().reset_index(name="n")
tri_counts = tri_counts.sort_values("n", ascending=False)
tri_counts.head(10)
```

### 分析二元组

```{python}
# 提及 "mansion" 最多的词
mansion_bigrams = bigrams_filtered[bigrams_filtered["word2"] == "mansion"]
mansion_bigrams.groupby(["book", "word1"]).size().reset_index(name="n").sort_values("n", ascending=False).head(10)
```

### 二元组的 tf-idf

```{python}
import numpy as np

bigrams_united = bigrams_filtered.copy()
bigrams_united["bigram"] = bigrams_united["word1"] + " " + bigrams_united["word2"]

# tf-idf
bg_counts = bigrams_united.groupby(["book", "bigram"]).size().reset_index(name="n")
n_docs = bg_counts["book"].nunique()
docs_per_bigram = bg_counts.groupby("bigram")["book"].nunique()
bg_counts["tf"] = bg_counts["n"] / bg_counts.groupby("book")["n"].transform("sum")
bg_counts["idf"] = np.log(n_docs / docs_per_bigram.reindex(bg_counts["bigram"]).values)
bg_counts["tf_idf"] = bg_counts["tf"] * bg_counts["idf"]
bg_counts = bg_counts.sort_values("tf_idf", ascending=False)
bg_counts.head(10)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-bigramtfidf-py
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》上下半部中 tf-idf 最高的二元组（Python）"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = ["Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei"]
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

top12 = bg_counts.groupby("book").head(12)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 7))
for ax, book in zip(axes, sorted(top12["book"].unique())):
    sub = top12[top12["book"] == book].sort_values("tf_idf")
    ax.barh(sub["bigram"], sub["tf_idf"])
    ax.set_title(f"Book {book}")
    ax.set_xlabel("tf-idf")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### 使用二元组为情感分析提供上下文

```{python}
# "not" 后面跟着的词
afinn = pd.read_parquet("data/common/afinn.parquet")

not_words = (
    bigrams_df[bigrams_df["word1"] == "not"]
    .merge(afinn, left_on="word2", right_on="word", how="inner")
)
not_words["contribution"] = not_words["n"] * not_words["value"]
# 这里 n 需要从 bigram_counts 获取
not_words_full = (
    bigram_counts[bigram_counts["word1"] == "not"]
    .merge(afinn, left_on="word2", right_on="word", how="inner")
)
not_words_full["contribution"] = not_words_full["n"] * not_words_full["value"]
not_words_full = not_words_full.sort_values("contribution", key=abs, ascending=False)
not_words_full.head(20)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-notwordsplot-py
#| fig-cap: "'not' 后面的词对情感值的贡献（Python）"
top20 = not_words_full.head(20).sort_values("contribution")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
colors = ["#d62728" if c < 0 else "#2ca02c" for c in top20["contribution"]]
ax.barh(top20["word2"], top20["contribution"], color=colors)
ax.set_xlabel("Sentiment value * number of occurrences")
ax.set_ylabel('Words preceded by "not"')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

否定词上下文的综合分析：

```{python}
negation_words = ["not", "no", "never", "without"]
negated = (
    bigram_counts[bigram_counts["word1"].isin(negation_words)]
    .merge(afinn, left_on="word2", right_on="word", how="inner")
)
negated["contribution"] = negated["n"] * negated["value"]
negated = negated.sort_values("contribution", key=abs, ascending=False)

# 每个否定词取 top 12
top_negated = (
    negated.groupby("word1")
    .apply(lambda g: g.nlargest(12, "contribution", keep="first"))
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-negatedwords-py
#| fig-cap: "否定词后面的常见正面或负面词（Python）"
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
for ax, neg in zip(axes.flat, negation_words):
    sub = top_negated[top_negated["word1"] == neg].sort_values("contribution")
    colors = ["#d62728" if c < 0 else "#2ca02c" for c in sub["contribution"]]
    ax.barh(sub["word2"], sub["contribution"], color=colors)
    ax.set_title(f'"{neg}" + ...')
    ax.set_xlabel("Sentiment * count")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### 用 networkx 绘制二元组网络

```{python}
import networkx as nx

# 过滤高频二元组
common_bigrams = bigram_counts[bigram_counts["n"] > 25].dropna()
G = nx.DiGraph()
for _, row in common_bigrams.iterrows():
    G.add_edge(row["word1"], row["word2"], weight=row["n"])

print(f"节点数: {G.number_of_nodes()}, 边数: {G.number_of_edges()}")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-bigramgraph-py
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》中常见的二元组网络（Python）"
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 12))
pos = nx.spring_layout(G, k=1.5, seed=2017)
nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, node_size=200, node_color="lightblue", ax=ax)
nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, alpha=0.3, arrows=True, ax=ax)
nx.draw_networkx_labels(G, pos, font_size=8, ax=ax)
ax.set_title("Bigram Network (n > 25)")
ax.axis("off")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 用 pandas 计算和关联词对

按每10行一段划分文本，计算词对共现。

```{python}
# 标记 linenumber 和 section
hongloumeng_en["linenumber"] = range(1, len(hongloumeng_en) + 1)
hongloumeng_en["section"] = hongloumeng_en["linenumber"] // 10

# 展开为每行一词（仅保留非停止词）
def tokenize_clean(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    return [w.lower() for w in nltk.word_tokenize(text) if w.isalpha() and w.lower() not in en_stopwords]

hongloumeng_en["words_clean"] = hongloumeng_en["text"].apply(tokenize_clean)
section_words = hongloumeng_en[["section"]].copy().assign(word=hongloumeng_en["words_clean"]).explode("word")
section_words = section_words[section_words["word"].str.len() > 0]
section_words.head()
```

### 词对共现计数

```{python}
from itertools import combinations

# 按 section 计算词对共现
pairs_list = []
for sec, group in section_words.groupby("section"):
    words = group["word"].unique()
    for w1, w2 in combinations(sorted(words), 2):
        pairs_list.append({"word1": w1, "word2": w2})

word_pairs = pd.DataFrame(pairs_list)
word_pair_counts = word_pairs.groupby(["word1", "word2"]).size().reset_index(name="n")
word_pair_counts = word_pair_counts.sort_values("n", ascending=False)
word_pair_counts.head(10)
```

### 词对相关度（phi 系数）

```{python}
# 计算 phi 系数（等价于 Pearson 相关系数在二元数据上）
# 先过滤高频词
word_freq = section_words["word"].value_counts()
common_words = set(word_freq[word_freq >= 20].index)
section_common = section_words[section_words["word"].isin(common_words)]

# 构建 section×word 的二元矩阵
cross = pd.crosstab(section_common["section"], section_common["word"])

# 计算 phi 系数
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

correlations = []
words_list = sorted(cross.columns)
for i, w1 in enumerate(words_list):
    for w2 in words_list[i+1:]:
        r, _ = pearsonr(cross[w1], cross[w2])
        correlations.append({"item1": w1, "item2": w2, "correlation": r})

word_cors = pd.DataFrame(correlations)
word_cors = word_cors.sort_values("correlation", ascending=False)
word_cors.head(10)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-wordcors-py
#| fig-cap: "与特定词相关度最高的词（Python）"
target_words = ["yue", "ounces", "married", "red"]
top_cors = word_cors[word_cors["item1"].isin(target_words)]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 8))
for ax, tw in zip(axes.flat, target_words):
    sub = top_cors[top_cors["item1"] == tw].head(8).sort_values("correlation")
    ax.barh(sub["item2"], sub["correlation"])
    ax.set_title(f'Correlated with "{tw}"')
    ax.set_xlabel("Correlation")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### 词对相关度网络

```{python}
#| label: fig-wordcorsnetwork-py
#| fig-cap: "词对相关度网络（Python）"
high_cors = word_cors[word_cors["correlation"] > 0.20]
G_corr = nx.Graph()
for _, row in high_cors.iterrows():
    G_corr.add_edge(row["item1"], row["item2"], weight=row["correlation"])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 10))
pos = nx.spring_layout(G_corr, k=1.5, seed=2016)
nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G_corr, pos, node_size=300, node_color="lightblue", ax=ax)
nx.draw_networkx_edges(G_corr, pos, alpha=0.3, ax=ax)
nx.draw_networkx_labels(G_corr, pos, font_size=8, ax=ax)
ax.set_title("Word Correlation Network (phi > 0.20)")
ax.axis("off")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## R vs Python 对比

| 任务 | R | Python |
|---|---|---|
| n-gram 分词 | `unnest_tokens(token="ngrams")` | `pairwise()` / `nltk.ngrams()` |
| 拆分二元组 | tidyr `separate()` | `str.split()` + `expand=True` |
| tf-idf | `bind_tf_idf()` | 手动计算 |
| 否定词分析 | `inner_join(AFINN)` | `merge(afinn)` |
| 共现计数 | widyr `pairwise_count()` | `itertools.combinations` |
| 相关度 | widyr `pairwise_cor()` | `scipy.stats.pearsonr` |
| 网络图 | igraph + ggraph | networkx + matplotlib |

Python 的 nltk 提供了灵活的分词和 n-gram 工具，但 widyr 的 pairwise 函数在 R 中更为简洁。网络可视化方面 networkx 功能强大但语法较冗长。
